summary: Module 14 starts. An open-weight model is one whose weights you can download (not the same as open source; read the license), and its size is arithmetic: parameters times bits per weight divided by 8. You measure real models on a laptop (988 MB against 278 MB for the same 0.5 billion model, memory and speed), and see what quantization trades.
goal: M14: say what VRAM and quantization mean.

items.text: Find a small instruct model on Hugging Face and read its license and size
Download it and read its size from the files, or with the tool's own command
Predict the size of a 1.5 billion model in 4 bits, then check it
On paper, say which models in the table would not fit your memory in 16 bits and in 4 bits
Write docs/models.md: your memory, three models, sizes in 16 and 4 bits, license, and fits or not
Play the Memory Check game to the end and see your score
